items.title: Ferrand Clementin Interview, 1973-08-02
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] How was... How was the Dijon's band? Was it the same... ...like... ...Ruby Shoes' band?

ctx.x: Much of Gramersi? That's further than Reserved, yeah. Yeah.

Yeah. But I'm talking about a nice hall, they can't have that. Yeah. That... ...the Dijon used to fill all the time. Uh-huh. ...and Dijon used to come in a hall hall, same way, you know. ...and... ...we had a nice hall, he was in the Marines. And... ...and... ...Loopy Shoes... ...he would then come out there, you know. Yeah.
How was... How was the Dijon's band? Was it the same... ...like... ...Ruby Shoes' band? No, no, yeah.
